_doc: Bambu Lab PLA Basic, printed, for analysis: stiffness and strength along the layers (x-y) and across them (z). Printed values vary with the printer, settings and spool: measure your own (the lever bench does) and record it as kind measured.
name: pla

modulus.source: Bambu Lab PLA Basic technical data sheet V2.0 (ISO 527), https://www.impresoras3d.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/TDS-Bambu-PLA-Basic-Technical-Data-Sheet.pdf

modulus_z.source: Bambu Lab PLA Basic technical data sheet V2.0 (ISO 527)

strength.source: Bambu Lab PLA Basic technical data sheet V2.0 (ISO 527), as quoted by resellers: check the current sheet

poisson.source: Typical for PLA; Farah, Anderson, Langer (2016), Physical and mechanical properties of PLA, Advanced Drug Delivery Reviews 107

density.source: Bambu Lab PLA Basic technical data sheet V2.0

softening.rule: Heat deflection temperature, ISO 75 at 0.45 MPa: where a part under a little load starts to creep
softening.source: Bambu PLA Basic Technical Data Sheet, ISO 75 at 0.45 MPa, https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0380/5149/files/Bambu_PLA_Basic_Technical_Data_Sheet.pdf
